In the following exercises, use the given $LU$ factorizations to solve the equations $A\xvec = \bvec$.

Solve the equation $$ A\xvec = \left[\begin{array}{rr} 1 \amp 0 \\ -2 \amp 1 \\ \end{array}\right] \left[\begin{array}{rr} 3 \amp 1 \\ 0 \amp -2 \\ \end{array}\right]\xvec = \twovec{-3}{0}\text{.} $$

Solve the equation $$ A\xvec = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 1 \amp 0 \amp 0 \\ -2 \amp 1 \amp 0 \\ -1 \amp 2 \amp 1 \\ \end{array}\right] \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 2 \amp 1 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp -1 \amp 3 \\ 0 \amp 0 \amp 1 \\ \end{array}\right]\xvec = \threevec{5}{-5}{7}\text{.} $$
